title: Resolution of singularities in characteristic zero
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: A complete proof of functorial principalization and resolution of singularities for schemes of finite type over a field of characteristic zero: smooth blow-ups and transforms of ideals, blow-up sequence functors and gluing, derivative ideals under blowing up, hypersurfaces of maximal contact and their uniqueness up to etale equivalence, going up, tuning, order reduction for ideals and for marked ideals by induction on dimension, principalization, resolution with an snc exceptional divisor compatible with smooth morphisms, smooth compactifications with snc boundary, and elimination of indeterminacy.
prerequisites: AG-CA (regular local rings, Kahler differentials, completion, Cohen structure)
AI Integrated Stacks Project: blowing up, strict transforms, Nagata compactification, smooth and etale morphisms
consumers: ag-etale-cohomology/comparison-with-singular-cohomology (proper smooth model, Corollary 5.1 of the last lesson)
Riemann existence bridge (smooth compactification with snc boundary, Corollary 5.2 of the last lesson)
free_sources: Kollar, Resolution of singularities - Seattle lecture, arXiv:math/0508332
Wlodarczyk, Simple Hironaka resolution in characteristic zero, arXiv:math/0401401
Hauser 2003, Bull. AMS (free from the AMS)
source_corrections: functorial depth-based separation of the components of E instead of a count of components (last lesson, Remark 1.4)
lemma that empty members of the ordered divisor do not change order reduction (last lesson, Lemma 2.1)
principalization is an isomorphism outside cosupp(I) together with Sing E (last lesson, Remark 3.2)
componentwise monomial part, needed for functoriality under non-surjective smooth morphisms (order reduction for marked ideals)
two typos in the formulas for derivatives under blowing up and for maximal coefficient ideals
